basis: Four actual rendered panels per recovered character; original plus previous runtime. No combat animation validation is implied.
overall: All 14 recovered originals have coherent static silhouettes with no observed gross body loss. Several restore source equipment absent from newer reconstructed bodies. Their unrigged/static state is an activation blocker until derived rigging and true-equipment contacts pass.

commonGates: Canonicalize raw +X Tripo facing using -90-degree glTF Y transform before any rig fit. Standard-provider originals already face +Z.
Preserve source geometry/textures in originals; optimize only derived outputs. Tripo originals have approximately 55–59k triangles with three 2048px textures and need mobile budgeting.
All original outputs have zero usable motion clips; three have static 24-bone rigs, eleven are unrigged. Retargeted idle/walk/attack/hit/death/dodge must be reviewed.
Remove added runtime weapons/shield only when corresponding retained original geometry is rigidly bound and sockets match its true extremities.
Maintain handheld blades for Dusk Rogue, Knife Rogue, Lion Knight and Silver Knight; their recovered originals do not provide gripped attack blades.
Re-run grounded locomotion, strike contacts, projectile muzzle, range and no-duplicate-equipment tests across all14 derived models.
staticLimitations: No severe static visual regression was identified that warrants discarding an original. Cloth, wings, chains, fingers, thin staff/scythe parts can still fail during animation; these are unverified, not demonstrated defects.
